body.mandate: Cut each board item (a whole project that mixes altitudes) into units of work at single altitudes: the loops and LLM calls it is made of, each with the lowest altitude that suffices and the capability primitives it needs. Loop until the answer is valid JSON, then stop.

inputs.title: The semantic graph: days, festivals, organisers, events, sessions, places, personas; everything linked
inputs.done_means: data/graph/ holds one small JSON file per entity type (days, festivals, organisers, events, sessions, places, personas, topics) with stable ids and typed links (festival hasEvent, organiser runs, event hasSession, event at place, event forPersona, event about topic); Portugal Tech Week and other umbrellas group their events; organisers deduplicated (one per organisation, never a private person); /

inputs.title: Connect the dots: the fringe graph
inputs.done_means: /graph/ shows events, communities, topics and places with filters

inputs.title: Give us the intel: data collection everywhere
inputs.done_means: a small 'Seen an event? Give us the intel' box on the home page and every event page (posting to /tip/'s lane); a 'Share to WhatsApp' button that sends a ?via=whatsapp-<group> link; outreach.1's group message asks people to paste their events at /tip/; /tip/'s status counts (tips received today, listed) on the dashboard

inputs.title: The loop: consume every organiser's public feed, on a schedule
inputs.done_means: sources.md lists every public calendar and events site we read (Luma calendars, events.portugaltechweek.com, Meetup, Eventbrite) with what its terms allow; the researcher re-reads each at least hourly until Friday 13 and records new, changed and cancelled events in data/events.json with read_at; a change shows on /changes/ (work/15)

body.return: commit tasks/<id>/result-<your agent>.json (node abp/tools/packets.mjs run --id <id> --as <your agent> --env <your runtime and account>)
